threat_event: Unauthorized remote changes to county building schedules and setpoints through the shared SYS-02 'oncall' account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared account with a password only, used by 3 technicians; remote write enabled for the 4 county buildings; password unchanged from early 2026 until 2026-07-16; no log review
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: AC-2, IA-2); CT-C 24-hour incident notice
existing_controls: Password changed 2026-07-16; vendor lockout after failed sign-ins; outbound-only gateway tunnels
treatment_plan: Retire the 'oncall' account; named SYS-02 accounts with MFA for each technician; weekly review of SYS-02 writes against work orders

threat_event: Takeover of a SYS-01 administrator account unlocks doors at county buildings, creates credentials, or exports cardholder data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 technicians hold full administrator rights; no alert on new administrators or schedule changes; no log review; MFA push approvals not checked
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: AC-6, AU-6); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6)(a)
existing_controls: MFA on administrator accounts; vendor audit trail; local lockdown buttons at the administration building
treatment_plan: Operator roles for daily work and 2 administrator accounts only; alerts for new administrators and door schedule changes; weekly audit trail review; number matching for MFA

threat_event: Former workforce member signs in to SYS-01, SYS-02, the gateways, or the suite after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No termination checklist; former Security Systems Technician's SYS-01 administrator account active 2026-04-17 to 2026-07-15; shared passwords not changed at departures
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: AC-2, PS-4); FAR 52.204-9(b) (PIV return)
existing_controls: Account disabled 2026-07-15 (audit trail showed no use after departure); MFA on SYS-01
treatment_plan: Same-day termination checklist across all platforms, gateways, shared secrets, keys, and PIV return; monthly account reconciliation

threat_event: Attacker exploits outdated gateway firmware or a weak gateway login to reach county and city BAS networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware 2 releases behind on 5 of 7 gateways; gateway VPN has no MFA; technician VPN reaches the whole BAS network; no advisory monitoring
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; customer BAS networks; BP-01; BP-03
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: SI-2, AC-17); CT-M city standards
existing_controls: Outbound-only tunnels; no inbound services from the internet
treatment_plan: Quarterly firmware review and update in approved windows; MFA on the gateway VPN; VPN limited to supervisory and engineering ports; monthly CISA ICS advisory check

threat_event: Ransomware from a phishing email encrypts technician laptops that hold the only copies of controller programs and door schedules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Technicians are local administrators; engineering folders excluded from sync and backup; no phishing training; MSP alerts business hours only
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: CP-9, SI-3); FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(xiii)
existing_controls: MSP antivirus and monthly patching; laptop encryption; MFA on the suite
treatment_plan: Engineering repository in the suite (backed up by SYS-08); MSP-managed endpoint detection and response with after-hours alerting; phishing training; separate local administrator account

threat_event: Controller programs, gateway configurations, or SYS-01 and SYS-02 settings cannot be restored after a failure or deletion
threat_source: Laptop failure, loss, or operator error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only copies on technician laptops; no configuration exports from SYS-01 or SYS-02; no restore test; SYS-08 never tested
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: CP-9, CP-4); county and city service levels
existing_controls: Some customers hold old program copies; vendor platform backups
treatment_plan: Central engineering repository with monthly exports; quarterly restore tests of programs and SYS-08

threat_event: CUI drawings from the federal building are disclosed to people without a need to know
threat_source: Staff error or outside party with a shared link
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI in the general shared folder; no marking routine; 'anyone with the link' sharing allowed; no CUI training
regulatory_driver: C-GOVERNMENT-R01 (CT-F: 32 CFR 2002 and GSA Order PBS 3490.3 via the subcontract; BTTRG 1.6.1 report via the prime)
existing_controls: Link removed 2026-07-20 and reported to the prime 2026-07-21
treatment_plan: Restricted CUI folder for 4 named people; block 'anyone' links on it; CUI training; marking kept on copies

threat_event: A part supplied to the federal building contains covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment, or a FASCSA-prohibited article
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No screening before CT-F purchases; marketplace purchases; no SAM.gov FASCSA search
existing_controls: Most parts from 2 authorized distributors; P07 traced the 6 items supplied in 2026
treatment_plan: Screening checklist and approved supplier list for CT-F purchases; SAM.gov FASCSA search before each order and at least quarterly

threat_event: A customer or legal notice deadline is missed during an incident (county and city 24 hours; prime immediately; Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a) 10 days)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan before 2026-08-31; clocks not written down; one person (Office and Compliance Manager) knows the contracts
regulatory_driver: CT-C and CT-M 24-hour notice; C-GOVERNMENT-R01 (CT-F BTTRG 1.6.1 via the prime); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a)
existing_controls: Cyber insurance hotline
treatment_plan: P08 runbook and notification matrix; reporting card for every technician; tabletop with the county and MSP

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool reaches every company laptop and, through them, the gateway VPN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMM agent with administrator rights on all laptops; no evidence of MFA on the RMM; MSP contract has no security or incident notice terms
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: SA-9, MA-4)
existing_controls: MSP is an established local firm; laptops encrypted
treatment_plan: MSP security addendum: MFA on the RMM, named technicians, 24-hour incident notice; yearly MSP review; certificate plus MFA on the gateway VPN so a laptop alone is not enough

threat_event: Cloud access control outage during an emergency prevents a timely lockdown or badge revocation at a county building
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor recovery time of 4 hours misses the 2-hour RTO; no written manual lockdown steps for the 2 libraries and the parks operations building
regulatory_driver: CT-C service levels (lockdown within 15 minutes)
existing_controls: Door controllers keep the last cardholder list; local lockdown buttons at the administration building
treatment_plan: Written manual lockdown steps and key lists for each county building, agreed with the county; yearly drill

threat_event: Face verification pilot causes harm: templates kept indefinitely, enrolled without written consent, unequal false rejections, or a template breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Turned on with no AI assessment; vendor default retention indefinite; no consent form; no bias testing; the vendor's SOC 2 does not cover the module
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(1)(g)1.a.(VI) and (2) (treated as biometric data; counsel to confirm); CT-C security exhibit
existing_controls: Badge always required; guard desk fallback
treatment_plan: Conditions in P10: consent, 30-day deletion after withdrawal, bias test, vendor data terms; no new enrollments until met

threat_event: On-call alarm response fails because of a single carrier, a single technician, or the loss of the only person who knows the gateways
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3-person on-call rotation; one cellular carrier; gateway configuration known only to the Lead Controls Technician
regulatory_driver: CT-C and CT-M service levels
existing_controls: Owner covers on-call; customer guards call the on-call phone
treatment_plan: Second-carrier hotspot and alarm email as a second path; gateway rebuild notes; train the Controls Technician as backup gateway administrator

threat_event: An intrusion into SYS-01, SYS-02, or the suite goes unnoticed for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No log review; no alerts; SYS-02 and suite logs kept less than one year
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: AU-6, AU-11)
existing_controls: Platform audit trails exist
treatment_plan: Weekly log review checklist; alerts to the Office and Compliance Manager and owner; monthly log export for one-year retention

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a customer payment or a supplier payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Invoices and bank details exchanged by email; no call-back rule; no phishing training
regulatory_driver: FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(vi) (FCI in the suite)
existing_controls: MFA on the suite; spam filtering
treatment_plan: Call-back rule for any bank detail change; phishing training (R-005)

threat_event: A technician laptop or tablet is stolen from a work van
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops carry VPN profiles and engineering data; tablets' encryption not confirmed
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: SC-28)
existing_controls: Laptop full-disk encryption; locked vans
treatment_plan: Confirm tablet encryption; certificate plus MFA on the VPN; remote wipe tested

threat_event: Security system plans, door schedules, or building drawings are released through a public records request or careless sharing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exempt documents not marked or separated; no procedure for requests routed by a customer's custodian
existing_controls: Customers' custodians handle requests
treatment_plan: Mark and store exempt documents as Restricted; public records procedure

threat_event: A hurricane closes the office and disrupts power and connectivity at customer buildings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single office internet line; 3 gateways without battery backup; staff also affected at home
regulatory_driver: CT-C and CT-M service levels
existing_controls: SaaS services are hosted outside the area; phones and laptops work from anywhere
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan; battery backup for 3 gateways; staff check-in plan

threat_event: The mechanical subcontractor or the MSP mishandles drawings or customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security terms beyond confidentiality; no incident notice duty
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: PS-7, SA-9)
existing_controls: Confidentiality clauses
treatment_plan: Security addendum with handling rules and 24-hour incident notice

threat_event: Staff paste door schedules, point lists, or cardholder data into a public generative AI chatbot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule on AI tools before 2026-08-31
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (confidentiality)
existing_controls: None before POL-02 C.2
treatment_plan: POL-02 C.2 and POL-04 4.7: no Restricted data in public AI tools; covered in training

threat_event: A GSA PIV card is lost or not returned when a holder leaves
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No PIV return step before 2026-08-31; 2 holders
existing_controls: Holders report loss to the prime; GSA can revoke the card
treatment_plan: Accepted by the owner 2026-08-31: low likelihood, GSA revocation limits harm; the PIV return step is added to the termination checklist under R-003

threat_event: The SYS-02 vendor's machine-learning alarm prioritization ranks a real critical alarm as low priority
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature on by default; alarm priorities partly set by the model
regulatory_driver: CT-C and CT-M service levels
existing_controls: Critical alarm classes are fixed by the technicians and always notify the on-call phone
treatment_plan: Accepted by the owner 2026-08-31 with monthly review of missed or downgraded alarms (P10 AI-002)

threat_event: A gateway is installed or replaced with the manufacturer default administrator password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No commissioning checklist; found on the parks operations building gateway in P07 testing (2026-08-05)
regulatory_driver: CT-C security exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate: IA-5)
existing_controls: Password changed the same evening (2026-08-05)
treatment_plan: Commissioning checklist with a default password check; unique passwords in a password manager; quarterly check of all 7 gateways
